title: OpenAI claims an ex-employee took its product plans and presented them to Apple
hook_text: Over one hundred OpenAI files taken
script:
A former OpenAI employee took more than one hundred files containing unreleased product plans.
The unnamed worker copied these confidential documents to a personal account before joining Apple.
OpenAI accused the former staff member of presenting this exact strategy directly to Apple leadership.
The meetings included the vice president of operations in Asia for Apple.
OpenAI disclosed these explosive allegations in a legal document filed on Wednesday.
This corporate espionage case exposes how intensely OpenAI and Apple are fighting over future AI secrets.
Would you trust your employees with your most guarded strategy?
